# The Places Where We Go

> > A couples travel blog featuring destination guides, travel tips, and a podcast for adventure seekers planning their next getaway.

The Places Where We Go is a travel resource created by Art and Julie, offering curated destination guides, travel itineraries, and practical planning advice for couples. The site features a popular travel podcast and aggregates booking tools and resources to help travelers plan adventures across destinations like California and beyond.
